```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(raster)
library(sf)
library(ncdf4)
library(terra)
```

# Okay, this is the marine heatwave data
## https://www.scidb.cn/en/detail?dataSetId=43cbc3b870e545a2a16967782103b557#p2

```{r}
nc <- nc_open("MarineHeatwaves/MHW2022/mhws_intensity_2022.01.nc")

vals <- ncvar_get(nc, "mhws_intensity")
lon <- ncvar_get(nc, "longitude")
lat <- ncvar_get(nc, "latitude")

nc_close(nc)

# create raster stack from 3D array (each layer = one day)
r <- rast(apply(vals, 3, function(x) {
  layer <- rast(t(x),
                extent = ext(0, 360, -90, 90),
                crs = "EPSG:4326")
  layer
}))

# flip and rotate
r <- flip(r, "vertical")
r <- rotate(r)

# plot first day
#plot(r[[1]])
#plot(world$geom, add = TRUE, border = "black")

vic_tas <- crop(r, ext(140, 150, -45, -35))

plot(vic_tas[[1]])
plot(world$geom, add = TRUE, border = "black")
```

```{r}
fishMaster <- read_csv("fishMaster.csv")

# Convert your data frame to sf points
pts <- st_as_sf(fishMaster, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Bounding box polygon
range_poly <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(pts))

# Expand the box by X degrees (e.g., 0.5 degrees)
bigger_box <- st_buffer(range_poly, dist = 0.5)

# crop to vic/tas using your bounding box
vic_tas <- crop(r, bigger_box)

# convert to dataframe
vic_tas_df <- as.data.frame(vic_tas, xy = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# rename layers to day numbers before converting to dataframe
names(vic_tas) <- paste0("day_", 1:31)

# convert to dataframe
vic_tas_df <- as.data.frame(vic_tas, xy = TRUE) |>
  rename(lon = x, lat = y)

# convert to long format
vic_tas_long <- vic_tas_df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(lon, lat),
               names_to = "day",
               values_to = "mhw_intensity") |>
  filter(!is.na(mhw_intensity))
```

want dataframe with all survey points MHW summed over the year (total intensity and # of heatwaves)

Note: The final map issue came from a combination of a slightly unusual NetCDF layout:

longitude/latitude stored as variables rather than dimension variables,
longitude using 0–360 convention,
latitude stored south-to-north, which needed flipping for raster display.

## Possibly needed code from MHWprocessing

```{r}
# get all nc files for 2012
files_2012 <- list.files("MarineHeatwaves/MHW2012", 
                          pattern = "\\.nc$", 
                          full.names = TRUE)

# check they're all there
length(files_2012)  # should be 12
files_2012  # check the filenames look right
```
